entities.summary: Arthur Torrane Urquhart was a naturalists & biologists in New Zealand (1839-10-27, New Zealand – 1916-10-03) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with environmental and ecological history. Advanced biological classification and ecological understanding.
